items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 10:43AM EDT until October 11 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
items.areaDesc: Westmoreland Ridges; Fayette Ridges; Higher Elevations of Indiana
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts between 40 to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Higher Elevations of Fayette, Higher Elevations of
Westmoreland, and Higher Elevations of Indiana Counties.

* WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 2 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Secure outdoor objects.

Please report downed trees, power lines or large branches by calling
412-262-1988, posting to the NWS Pittsburgh Facebook page, or using X
@NWSPittsburgh.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 2:32AM EDT until October 11 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS State College PA
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Cambria and Somerset Counties.

* WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 2 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds will occur to the west of
the tallest ridges.
items.instruction:
Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high
profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 10 at 2:02AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Gray ME
items.areaDesc: Kennebec; Interior Waldo; Coastal York; Coastal Cumberland; Sagadahoc; Lincoln; Knox; Coastal Waldo; Strafford; Eastern Hillsborough; Interior Rockingham
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 32 will result in frost
formation.

* WHERE...Portions of south central and southwest Maine and
central and southern New Hampshire.

* WHEN...From 2 AM to 8 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could kill sensitive outdoor vegetation if
left uncovered.
items.instruction:
A Frost Advisory means that widespread frost is expected.
Sensitive outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 10 at 10:27AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Caribou ME
items.areaDesc: Interior Hancock; Central Washington; Coastal Hancock; Coastal Washington
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the lower 30s will result in frost
formation.

* WHERE...Coastal Hancock, Coastal Washington, Central Washington,
and Interior Hancock Counties.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 8 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

items.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 10 at 2:02AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Gray ME
items.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 29 expected.

* WHERE...Central Interior Cumberland and Androscoggin Counties.

* WHEN...From 2 AM to 8 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions will kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
items.instruction:
A Freeze Warning means sub-freezing temperatures are imminent or
highly likely. These conditions will kill crops and other
sensitive vegetation.
